I read p.153 and the Lean. All three voters agree on verdict and relation, and I keep both. exists_initialTube with InitialTube.regular/all_radial_jets states clauses (i)-(ii) for f = E/√(2X), U, Ubar and Π on one tube chosen before the widths, which is stronger than the paper. ActualSlowAxis.base with base_beta_value adds V_0/X. The cone is initial_cones. (B.30) is natural_activation_direction, tied to the witness by nominal_activation_stress. Reservation is seed_activation, seed_agreement and fields_outside. No single declaration states the corollary, so it stays partial. I found no material difference: every finding is an attribution gap or a convention with a written recovery. Not vacuous: AssembledSlowBase.nominalTube instantiates the tube.

findings.summary: No single declaration states Corollary B.6. exists_initialTube with InitialTube.regular/all_radial_jets gives clauses (i)-(ii); the cone, (B.30), t_c and reservation clauses are stated faithfully by separate Prop B.5, nominal-assembly and modulation declarations.

InitialTube lists f, U, Ubar, Pi rather than V_0/X. But ActualSlowAxis.base carries V_0/X as its fifth component, an AxisFunction on the same complex parameter domain, and base_beta_value identifies it with radialFlux/X, i.e. (4.7).

No declaration states the finite bounds for radial derivatives on a smaller neighbourhood; all_radial_jets concludes only Regular. The bounds follow in one line from continuity on a compact subset of the open domain.

Lean has no named t_c. initial_cones gives a collar t ≤ activationTime ≤ referenceWidth, and the reserved collar X_0·e^{t/2} is chosen inside nominalBounds_of_certificate. The paper's strict t_c and 4e^{t_c} < 4.1 are recovered by shrinking.

The auditor left open whether ActivationCone.activatedStress is the witness's stress. nominal_activation_stress proves it for y ≤ referenceWidth, and modulated_activation_stress carries it to the final modulated profile on the reserved collar.

The auditor's recovery of the reservation clause used only seed_agreement, which misses the Appendix C modulation. Lean covers it: the modulated profile equals W outside (modulation.left, repairPatch.right), with modulation.left > X_0.

natural_activation_direction exports positivity of B_0(0,η) but not the identity B_0(0,η) = F·p_{s,r} of (B.30). exists_actual_stress_direction states the identity, and natural_reference_log_match discharges its matching hypothesis for the natural profile.
